caption: The camera capture, the first bar of the top lane, is the extra 33 ms the optical path never pays. The bars end at 68 ms and 20 ms, so at a 60°/s head turn the video view misregisters 4.08° (10.7 cm at 1.5 m) against 1.20° (3.1 cm), 3.4 times worse.

spec.aria: Timeline of AR display delay: the video see-through lane runs capture 0 to 33 ms, pose 33 to 53 ms and display 53 to 68 ms, ending at 68 ms, while the optical see-through lane ends at 20 ms; at 60 degrees per second these give 4.08 degrees and 1.20 degrees of misregistration.
